answer: My answer to sybils is Gazetted forex dealer licence with markets authority attestation — a licence the authority renews after transaction audits — which makes the willow of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the pearl is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The fable grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
